tracks.legalName: Application for Expungement of a Non-Conviction Arrest Record, HRS § 831-3.2

controllingAuthority.summary: Agency expungement through the Hawaii Criminal Justice Data Center at a single statewide office. Since July 1, 2025, HCJDC transmits every expungement order carrying a court case number to the Judiciary, which then seals or removes the court files from public electronic databases and issues an Order to Seal.

eligibleDispositions: arrest that did not result in a conviction, within the § 831-3.2 criteria

geography.venue: Statewide Hawaii agency process through HCJDC at a single statewide office.

destination.name: Hawaii Criminal Justice Data Center
destination.detail: Single statewide office. Orders issued before July 1, 2025 still require the person to contact the Judiciary directly.

participantInputs.question: What was the arrest — which agency, what date, and what were you accused of?
How did the matter end?
If a court case was opened, what is the case number?
participantInputs.conditionDescription: Asked so the order can reach the Judiciary for sealing.

supportingDocuments.name: Photo identification
supportingDocuments.howToObtain: Include a copy of your photo identification with the application.

supportingDocuments.name: Money order for the application fee
supportingDocuments.obtainedFrom: A post office, bank or store that issues money orders
supportingDocuments.howToObtain: Obtain a money order for the HCJDC fee and enclose it with the application.

supportingDocuments.name: Stamped self-addressed envelope
supportingDocuments.howToObtain: Enclose a stamped, self-addressed envelope so HCJDC can return the result.

manualCompletionItems.why: The applicant signs their own application.

officialSources.title: Hawaii Criminal Justice Data Center, expungement application

rules.filing: Submit the HCJDC application with photo identification, the money order and a stamped self-addressed envelope.
rules.fees: An application fee applies, paid by money order. The source review does not state the amount.
rules.feeWaiver: The source review does not address a fee waiver.
rules.notice: HCJDC decides on the application and, since July 1, 2025, transmits an order carrying a court case number to the Judiciary.
rules.participantSignature: The applicant signs their own application.
rules.notarization: The source review does not state a notarization requirement.

selfHelpStopConditions: The record is federal, military, or from another jurisdiction.
Any immigration matter.

unresolvedQuestions.question: Act 3, Session Laws of Hawaii 2025, and any chapter 91 rules adopted under § 831-3.2(h) have not been acquired.
